about_short_description.short_description: Finni Health is an MSO enabling ABA providers to start and grow their own in-network practices.

product.name: Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) Therapy
product.description: A therapy service using ABA techniques to help children with autism develop skills and reduce challenging behaviors.

product.name: Developmental Counseling
product.description: A service supporting children's learning through guided interactions to promote developmental progress.

product.name: Pediatric Diagnosis Facilitation
product.description: A service that assists families in obtaining referrals to psychologists and pediatricians for diagnostic evaluations.

product.name: Parent Training
product.description: Training programs designed to equip parents with skills to support their child's therapy and development.

product.name: Play Therapy
product.description: Therapeutic sessions using play to identify and address developmental goals with children.

product.name: Finni Parent Portal
product.description: A digital platform for parents to manage scheduling, track progress, and handle insurance and clinical documents.
